name: Ground Floor Industries
note: Official brand palette. The six core colors are the brand colors; the tints are derived from them for the logo and for contrast on dark backgrounds.

deep-teal.use: Right tower; INDUSTRIES tagline on light backgrounds; primary accent

evergreen.use: Second panel of the low building

mustard-gold.use: Left panel; gold edge on the light wordmark

charcoal.use: Wordmark on light backgrounds; dark background

cream.use: Wordmark on dark backgrounds; light background

teal-on-dark.use: INDUSTRIES tagline on dark backgrounds (readable contrast)

gold-light.use: Frames and foundation bars on dark backgrounds
